ns2:course.label: Econ Issues in Arch Develop
ns2:course.description: (ARCH 438) Individual and team analysis of architectural development proposals addressing relevant economic topics and trends. Proposals are analyzed for development, construction, finance, operation, and sale costs. Potential and projected rate of return on investment is established for specific time periods. Economic and social forces impacting upon real estate values are examined. Prerequisite: ARCH 501, ARCH 530, and ARCH 534; or consent of instructor.
